I need to verify whether J.K. Rowling won the 1999 Whitbread Children's Book of the Year award for "Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets."

The 1999 Whitbread Children's Book of the Year award was actually won by J.K. Rowling for "Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban," not "Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets."
